text_sanskrit: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः । प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ॥ ७-३० ॥
itrans: sAdhibhUtAdhidaivaM mA.n sAdhiyaj~na.n cha ye viduH . prayANakAle.api cha mA.n te viduryuktachetasaH .. 7-30 ..
translation: Those who know Me together with Adhibhuta and Adhidaiva, and with Adhiyagna and also at the time of departing, -those are the persons devoting their mind (to contemplation). (30.)  V The latter half may also be rendered thus: Those who remember Me even at the hour of departing are such as have devoted their minds to the Lord and depend upon Him and consequently they alone know that Brahman. (30)
